description: Eighth review, R3 (rollout, pwsh): `npm.cmd test` fails at the root; then `cd 'sub[1]' && npm.cmd test` passes. PowerShell's Set-Location reads `[1]` as a wildcard even in quotes and goes to `sub1`. A path component outside the closed set of characters, and a wildcard in a PowerShell location, are unplaced: WARN, never PASS.
